title: DEF CON 23 - Robinson and Mitchell - Knocking my neighbors kids cruddy drone offline
summary: A DEF CON 23 talk on researching whether a commercial quadcopter could be forced to land by interfering with its GPS signal, inspired by a neighbor's kid's drone. It covers the research and the legal and technical issues encountered.
why: HN brings it up in drone threads as a favorite tech talk and as evidence of how weak consumer drone security is.
